news_candidates.title_zh: 贝森特令日本央行在加息问题上陷入两难
news_candidates.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda faces unusually acute risks of financial-market turbulence as he approaches this month’s policy decision in the wake of a public pressure campaign by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 在美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特公开施压后，日本央行行长植田和男临近本月政策决定时，面临异常严峻的金融市场动荡风险。

news_candidates.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
news_candidates.title_zh: 伊朗称美军袭击婚礼致4人死亡为“战争罪”，美国否认针对平民
news_candidates.summary: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 伊朗媒体称，弹片击中一所住宅，死者包括两名儿童。随后伊朗向中东地区的美国目标发射导弹和无人机。

news_candidates.title: Fed’s Warsh Lays Out Data Dashboard to Read US Economy
news_candidates.title_zh: 美联储沃什列出解读美国经济的数据仪表盘
news_candidates.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh used his keynote speech in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, last week to map out some of the key data points he leans on to read the US economy, offering new insight into his approach to policy making.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美联储主席凯文·沃什上周在怀俄明州杰克逊霍尔的主题演讲中，列出其判断美国经济所依赖的关键数据指标，展现其政策制定方法。

news_candidates.title: ADP Says US Companies Added 38,000 Jobs in August
news_candidates.title_zh: ADP：美国企业8月新增就业3.8万人，低于预期
news_candidates.summary: Private payrolls rose by 38,000 in August according to ADP research. Economists expected a gain of 47,000. This was the smallest increase since the start of the year. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: ADP数据显示，美国私营部门8月新增3.8万个岗位，低于经济学家预期的4.7万个，且为年初以来最小增幅。

news_candidates.title: ING Told to Add Capital by Australia Watchdog After Failings
news_candidates.title_zh: ING因违规被澳大利亚监管机构要求增加资本
news_candidates.summary: Australia’s banking regulator put additional capital requirements on ING Bank Australia Ltd. after the lender revealed it had misreported its liquidity position over several years.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 贷款机构披露多年来错误报告流动性状况后，澳大利亚银行监管机构对ING Bank Australia Ltd.提出额外资本要求。

news_candidates.title: Trump may be forced to reveal secret rules feds use for AI safety testing
news_candidates.title_zh: 特朗普或被迫公开联邦政府用于人工智能安全测试的秘密规则
news_candidates.summary: Trump’s secret reviews of frontier AI models may hide corruption, lawsuit says.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 一桩诉讼称，特朗普对前沿人工智能模型的秘密审查可能掩盖腐败。

news_candidates.title: Tim Cook handed $47m package for new role as executive chair of Apple
news_candidates.title_zh: 蒂姆·库克获4700万美元苹果执行董事长新职位薪酬方案
news_candidates.summary: Pay and shares deal nearly matches $58m award to John Ternus, his successor as CEO at the $4.7tn tech company Tim Cook has received a $47m (£35m) pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a remuneration package that nears the level set for his successor as chief executive. Cook, who handed over to John Ternus on Tuesday, will be paid a base salary of $2m and $45m worth of shares . Half of the share award will be based on performance targets being met, while the remaining half will be paid out over four years. Continue reading...
news_candidates.summary_zh: 苹果执行董事长蒂姆·库克获得4700万美元薪酬方案，接近其继任首席执行官约翰·特努斯的5800万美元奖励。库克基本年薪为200万美元，另获价值4500万美元股票。

news_candidates.title: USTR's Greer huddles with House Republicans amid Trump trade spats
news_candidates.title_zh: 美贸易代表格里尔在特朗普贸易争端中与众议院共和党人会谈
news_candidates.summary: Trump's plan to lower tariffs on 300,000 metric tons of imported beef caused an uproar among cattle ranchers.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 特朗普降低30万吨进口牛肉关税的计划，引发牧场主强烈反弹。

news_candidates.title: Malaysia Set to Hold Rates as Investors Bet on Tightening Ahead
news_candidates.title_zh: 投资者押注未来收紧政策之际，马来西亚料维持利率不变
news_candidates.summary: Malaysia’s central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged on Thursday, with subdued inflation giving policymakers little reason to tighten despite resilient economic growth.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 预计马来西亚央行周四维持利率不变，温和通胀使政策制定者即便面对有韧性的经济增长，也几乎没有理由收紧政策。

news_candidates.title: CJ Desai Says MongoDB’s AI Momentum Is Real, But Guidance Remains Prudent
news_candidates.title_zh: CJ·德赛称MongoDB人工智能势头真实，但指引仍审慎
news_candidates.summary: CJ Desai, CEO of MongoDB, says MongoDB feels very good about demand, noting Atlas delivered its fifth straight quarter of 29% growth and that total Atlas dollars continue to rise quarter over quarter. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: MongoDB首席执行官CJ·德赛称，公司对需求感觉很好，Atlas连续第五个季度增长29%，其美元收入总额继续环比增长。他接受《收盘》节目采访。

news_candidates.title: DigitalBridge's Ganzi Says Data Centers Are 'Not the Villain'
news_candidates.title_zh: DigitalBridge甘齐称数据中心“不是反派”
news_candidates.summary: Marc Ganzi, CEO of DigitalBridge, says AI infrastructure investing needs a diversified approach, but argues the real bottleneck is power. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Ganzi also says the industry cannot focus only on chips or software and stresses that the AI buildout should not be politicized. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: DigitalBridge首席执行官马克·甘齐称，人工智能基础设施投资需要多元化方法，真正瓶颈在于电力。他还表示，行业不能只关注芯片或软件，人工智能建设不应被政治化。

news_candidates.title: Snowflake Jumps on Revenue Outlook, Uptake of AI Assistant
news_candidates.title_zh: Snowflake上调营收展望并称人工智能助手采用迅速，股价上涨
news_candidates.summary: Snowflake Inc. gained in extended trading after the company raised its outlook for annual sales, topping analysts’ estimates, and touted rapid adoption of its AI-assisted coding tool.
news_candidates.summary_zh: Snowflake上调年度销售额展望，超过分析师预期，并称其人工智能辅助编程工具获快速采用，盘后股价上涨。

news_candidates.title: Lutnick Says Anthropic Has Patched Relations With US Government
news_candidates.title_zh: 卢特尼克称Anthropic已修复与美国政府的关系
news_candidates.summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said that Anthropic PBC has patched its relationship with the Trump administration, signaling a possible end to months of sharp differences over security between the US and the artificial intelligence developer.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克称，Anthropic已修复与特朗普政府的关系，表明双方围绕安全问题持续数月的严重分歧可能结束。

news_candidates.title: Altman Says AI Will Be Greatest Boom in Business the World Has Ever Seen
news_candidates.title_zh: 奥特曼称人工智能将成为全球史上最大的商业繁荣
news_candidates.summary: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman says artificial intelligence will be the greatest boom in business the world has ever seen. He speaks to US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at a tech event in North Carolina hosted by the US for G20 members. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼称，人工智能将成为世界有史以来最大的商业繁荣。他在美国为二十国集团成员举办的北卡罗来纳州科技活动上与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克交谈。

news_candidates.title: Expect Three To Five Multitrillion Dollar AI Cos.: DJ Deb
news_candidates.title_zh: DJ·德布预计将出现3至5家市值数万亿美元的人工智能公司
news_candidates.summary: DJ Deb, co-founder and CEO of Francisco Partners, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the fallout from the stress around software companies, and the money backing the numerous firms tied to AI. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: Francisco Partners联合创始人兼首席执行官DJ·德布在《彭博交易》节目中讨论软件公司承压的后果，以及支持众多人工智能相关企业的资金。

news_candidates.title: Rocket Lab’s Hungry Hippo completes testing
news_candidates.title_zh: 火箭实验室“饥饿河马”完成测试
news_candidates.summary: With Rocket Lab targeting to launch its Neutron vehicle by the end of this year,… The post Rocket Lab’s Hungry Hippo completes testing appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .
news_candidates.summary_zh: 火箭实验室计划在今年年底前发射其中子号运载火箭，其“饥饿河马”已完成测试。

news_candidates.title: Google says its new Gemini 3.8 Flash model ‘works harder’ but might cost more
news_candidates.title_zh: 谷歌称新Gemini 3.8 Flash模型“工作更努力”，但成本可能更高
news_candidates.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, arriving just a few weeks after its predecessor. The company claims the new model "works harder" than Gemini 3.7 Flash by performing more reasoning steps on complex tasks and "calling tools iteratively." It has the same introductory pricing as 3.7 Flash, $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: 谷歌推出Gemini 3.8 Flash，距前代发布仅数周。公司称该模型在复杂任务中会进行更多推理步骤并迭代调用工具。其初始定价与3.7 Flash相同。

news_candidates.title: NASA Revamps Challenge Linking Community College Studies to Aerospace Careers
news_candidates.title_zh: NASA更新挑战赛，连接社区大学学习与航空航天职业
news_candidates.summary: Community college students across the U.S. now have another opportunity to discover how their education can lead to fulfilling roles at the forefront of aerospace, science, engineering, and technology. The updated NASA Community College Aerospace Scholars (NCAS) student challenge invites students to learn about the agency and its missions, engage with NASA experts, and explore […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美国各地社区大学学生现可通过更新后的NASA社区大学航空航天学者学生挑战赛，了解教育如何通向航空航天、科学、工程和技术领域的职业，并与NASA专家交流。

news_candidates.title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
news_candidates.title_zh: 西班牙爆发抗议，反对政府处理休达移民危机的方式
news_candidates.summary: Spanish opposition parties accuse Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning the residents of Ceuta.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 西班牙反对党指责首相佩德罗·桑切斯抛弃了休达居民。

news_candidates.title: NASA’s Hubble Tracks New Decagon Encircling Saturn’s South Pole
news_candidates.title_zh: NASA哈勃望远镜追踪环绕土星南极的新十边形结构
news_candidates.summary: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope observes a giant, evolving, 10-sided atmospheric wave encircling Saturn’s south pole.
news_candidates.summary_zh: NASA哈勃太空望远镜观测到一个巨大且不断演变的十边形大气波，环绕土星南极。

news_candidates.title: Researchers fear safety disaster ahead of OpenAI’s Astra release
news_candidates.title_zh: 研究人员担忧OpenAI Astra发布将带来安全灾难
news_candidates.summary: OpenAI is on the cusp of releasing its most powerful AI model yet, Astra, following weeks of delays to shore up safety protocols after its agents attacked real targets during testing. As details about the model trickle out, researchers are warning it "may be the single worst development for AI security/safety to date." Shortly after […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: OpenAI在数周延迟并强化安全协议后，即将发布其最强大的人工智能模型Astra；测试期间其智能体曾攻击真实目标。研究人员警告，这可能是迄今人工智能安全领域最糟糕的发展。
